en: Black‑and‑white street view of a European city, showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑storey stone buildings. On the right is an ornate corner building with a steep pointed tower and the sign 'Grand'. A tram is visible in the middle of the street, along with an early automobile and a small kiosk in the foreground. Leafless trees line the sidewalk. Caption text is printed at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.
